name: Erth Abu Dhabi (SAMPLE)
source: Demo tenant. Public facts from erth.ae (accommodations, dining, services, fitness) and the property fact sheet, as already used in src/config/resort.ts. Not an official Erth product. Room rates are not published there, so ratePerNight is null and reservations confirm the rate; maxGuests is the published occupancy; count is demo inventory for the booking simulator, not real availability.

locations.name: Erth Abu Dhabi
locations.address: Khor Al Maqta, Al Khaleej Al Arabi Road, Abu Dhabi

faqs.a: Free private on-site parking, no reservation needed. EV charging and accessible parking are available.
faqs.keywords: parking park car valet ev charging

faqs.a: Yes, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi in rooms and public areas.
Pets are not permitted. For service animals, please confirm with reservations in advance.
faqs.keywords: pet pets dog dogs cat animal

faqs.a: Khor Al Maqta, Al Khaleej Al Arabi Road, Abu Dhabi. About 15 minutes from downtown and about 15 minutes' drive from Zayed International Airport, near Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque.
faqs.keywords: where location address directions airport downtown mosque

faqs.a: Al Rimal for the Emirati-inspired buffet, Ergon Deli and Cafe, Asrah by the pool, and Beetza for Neapolitan pizza. Halal meals are provided across dining outlets.
faqs.keywords: restaurant restaurants dining food eat dinner lunch breakfast buffet halal pizza

faqs.a: Yes, 24-hour room service is available for in-house guests.
faqs.keywords: room service in-room order food night

faqs.a: Yes, the Valmont Spa, the first Valmont Spa in Abu Dhabi, open daily 11am to 8pm.

faqs.q: Is there a beach or pool?
faqs.a: There is a 350 metre private beach at Al Waryah and two outdoor pools, plus an indoor Olympic pool at Etizan.
faqs.keywords: beach pool pools swim swimming sea

faqs.a: Yes, Etizan Fitness has a large gym, a ladies gym, padel, tennis, squash, an indoor Olympic pool and more.
faqs.keywords: gym fitness padel tennis squash workout sport

faqs.q: Do you have a kids club?
faqs.a: Yes, there is a Kids Club with activities and play; please confirm ages and hours with the desk.
faqs.keywords: kids children child family club play

faqs.q: Can you arrange an airport transfer?
faqs.a: Airport pick-up and drop-off can be arranged, usually with a surcharge. Share your flight number and arrival time and the desk will arrange it.
faqs.keywords: airport transfer pickup pick-up shuttle taxi flight

faqs.q: Is a deposit needed at check-in?
faqs.a: A refundable damage deposit may apply at check-in; please confirm the amount with reservations. Photo ID and a credit card are typically required.

faqs.q: Do you host weddings and events?
faqs.a: Yes, there are 17 event venues including a ballroom, cinema and theatre, with a dedicated events team.
faqs.keywords: wedding weddings event events conference meeting ballroom venue

hotel.cancellationPolicy: Cancellation terms depend on the rate booked, so reservations will confirm them when they confirm your booking.
